==Description==
The '''Fruit Cake''' is a common consumable only obtainable through triumphing [[Pizza Party]] and [[Badlands II]] modes and via a [[Holiday Crate]], with a 26.25% chance. It can be used to regenerate base health.

==Usage==
When using the '''Fruit Cake''', a fruit cake will appear in the player's hand, which will be eaten upon use. This will heal the base health back by 5 every second for 10 seconds, healing up to 50 health. This consumable only has two uses, which means it can be used to regenerate up to 100 health. It can increase base health to be higher than its max health if the Over-Heal [[Skills|Skill]] is unlocked.

==Appearance==
Fruitcake or Fruit Cake, is a cake made with candied or dried fruit, nuts and spices, and optionally soaked in spirits.

==Strategy==
*Similar to the [[Turkey Leg]], it can be used to heal the base, although this should not be necessary if a player already has [[Medic]].
**Alongside this, it can be less reliable then [[Turkey Leg]], due to it not instantly healing the base.
